description.en: Hold the knife, push, blow the dust away

howToPlay.zh: 照着篆刻师傅的工序刻一方四字印：先倒边，再刻边框、刻十字分成四格，最后一笔一笔刻字。按在刀以外的地方拖动就是移刀，刀尖始终在手指上方；把刀尖放在稿线的一端，松手，再按住刀（刀柄、刀身或刚才手指停的地方）顺着线推：竖线往上推，横线往左或往右推。下刀后第一下推的方向决定这一刀，刀就压进石头一顿一顿地往前刻，往回拉会顺着刻过的槽退回，松手提刀。‹ › 可以转动印石，换个顺手的角度。手一偏、推过头，刀痕都会如实留在印上，不会刻坏。刻完按「吹」把石粉吹干净，印石转一圈展示，印蜕收进右上角的「印谱」，同时解锁下一方。印面上刻的是反字，盖出来才是正的。电脑上：鼠标移动就是移刀，按住左键顺着线拖就是刻。键盘：方向键移刀，按住空格下刀，再按上或左右方向键顺着线推、反方向往回拉，Q 和 E 转动印石，B 吹粉，A 打开印谱。
howToPlay.en: Carve a four-character seal the way a seal carver does: chamfer the face's edges, cut the border, cut a cross into four cells, then carve the characters stroke by stroke. Dragging anywhere away from the knife brings it along, its tip just above your finger. Set the tip at one end of a draft line, lift, then hold the knife (its handle, blade, or where your finger just was) and push along the line: up for upright lines, left or right for lines across. The first push after the knife goes in sets the cut's direction; the knife bites in and cuts ahead flake by flake, pulling back slides it down its own groove, and letting go lifts it. ‹ › turn the stone to a comfortable angle. Wobbles and overruns stay in the stone as they were cut, but nothing can be ruined. When all is cut, Blow clears the powder, the stone turns once, and the print goes into Seals (top right) and the next seal opens. The face is carved mirrored so that it prints the right way round. With a mouse: move to aim, hold the button and drag along a line to carve. Keyboard: arrow keys move the knife; hold Space to press it in, then Up, Left or Right pushes along a line and the opposite key pulls back; Q and E turn the stone, B blows, A opens your seals.
